Written by The Design Team

📍 Ponte Vedra, Florida | St. Johns County | Sawgrass

Natural wood cabinetry has made a strong return in kitchen design, but today’s approach looks very different from the darker wood kitchens many people remember from past decades. Instead of heavy stains and dark finishes, many homeowners are choosing lighter wood tones that showcase the natural grain while keeping the kitchen bright and modern.

This kitchen remodel is a great example of that approach. At the center of the design are white oak cabinets finished in a soft whitewash, paired with a frameless cabinet system from the Eclipse line. The result is a kitchen that feels clean, open, and contemporary while still celebrating the natural beauty of real wood.

Let’s take a closer look at the cabinet features that make this kitchen design stand out.

Whitewashed Oak Cabinets Highlight the Beauty of Real Wood

One of the most noticeable elements in this kitchen is the use of whitewashed white oak cabinetry. White oak has become one of the most requested cabinet materials in recent years because of its durability and distinctive grain pattern.

Instead of covering that grain with a dark stain or paint, the whitewash finish softens the color of the wood while allowing the natural texture to remain visible. The finish brightens the cabinets and reduces the contrast in the grain, creating a softer and more refined look.

Whitewashed oak works particularly well in kitchens because it helps achieve several design goals at once:

It keeps the room feeling light and open

It highlights the natural character of the wood

It complements both modern and transitional styles

The finish strikes a balance between traditional stained cabinetry and painted cabinets, making it a versatile option for many homes.

Frameless Cabinets Offer a Sleek, Modern Look

This kitchen uses frameless cabinetry, sometimes referred to as European-style cabinets. Unlike traditional face-frame cabinets, frameless cabinets eliminate the front frame and attach the doors directly to the cabinet box.

This construction method provides several benefits.

First, it allows for larger cabinet openings, which makes it easier to access the interior space. Without a face frame taking up room at the front of the cabinet, homeowners get more usable storage inside.

Second, frameless cabinets create clean, consistent lines across the kitchen. The tighter spacing between doors and drawers gives the cabinetry a streamlined appearance that fits well with modern design.

For homeowners who want both functionality and a contemporary look, frameless cabinetry is often an excellent choice.

A Clean Door Style Keeps the Design Timeless

The cabinets in this kitchen use the Napa door style, which features a simple five-piece construction with a framed center panel.

The design is intentionally understated. Rather than drawing attention with elaborate detailing, the door profile stays subtle so the natural wood grain becomes the focal point.

This approach helps the kitchen feel timeless. Door styles with simple lines tend to age better because they work well with a variety of design trends over time.

Paired with the whitewashed oak finish, the Napa door style creates a cabinet design that feels both modern and classic.

Soft-Close Hardware Improves Everyday Use

While the cabinet finish and door style create the visual impact, the internal hardware plays a major role in how the kitchen performs day to day.

This kitchen includes soft-close hinges and drawer systems, which allow cabinet doors and drawers to close smoothly instead of slamming shut. The mechanism engages automatically during the final inches of movement and gently pulls the door closed.

Soft-close hardware offers several advantages:

It reduces noise in the kitchen

It prevents wear on cabinet doors and hinges

It creates a more refined, high-quality feel

Many homeowners quickly realize that this small feature makes a big difference in daily use.

Durable Drawer Construction for Long-Term Performance

Another important cabinet detail in this kitchen is the use of hardwood drawer boxes.

Drawer boxes made from hardwood are stronger and more durable than those made from particleboard or thinner materials. They are designed to hold heavier items like cookware, utensils, and kitchen tools without flexing or weakening over time.

When paired with smooth soft-close drawer slides, hardwood drawers provide reliable performance that homeowners can depend on for years.

A Kitchen Designed for Both Cooking and Gathering

The cabinet layout in this kitchen supports both function and flow. The design includes a long wall of cabinetry paired with a central island that provides additional storage and workspace.

The wall run organizes cooking elements such as the range and surrounding cabinets, while the island adds extra prep space and creates a natural gathering area.

Because the cabinets are frameless, the interior storage space is especially efficient. Larger openings allow for better use of the cabinet interiors, helping homeowners keep the kitchen organized.

A Balanced Approach to Modern Kitchen Design

Modern kitchens sometimes risk feeling cold or overly minimal. This design avoids that problem by combining sleek cabinet construction with the warmth of natural wood.

The whitewashed oak finish adds texture and character, while the frameless cabinetry keeps the overall look clean and contemporary.

The result is a kitchen that feels bright, welcoming, and thoughtfully designed.

Explore Cabinet Options in Our Showroom

If you are planning a kitchen remodel, cabinetry will likely be one of the biggest design decisions you make. The materials, construction, and finish you choose will influence both the appearance and functionality of your kitchen.

Seeing cabinet styles in person can make that decision much easier.

Visit our Jacksonville showroom to explore cabinet finishes, door styles, and layout options with the help of our design team. We will help you create a kitchen that fits your home and the way you live.

Written by The Design Team

This Ponte Vedra home strikes a beautiful balance between relaxed coastal vibes and refined, custom detail. Designed and installed by our team at Woodsman Kitchens & Floors, every element was carefully selected to blend function, form, and flow across the kitchen and open living space.

In the Kitchen

At the heart of the home is a spacious and soothing kitchen anchored by custom cabinetry from Shiloh. We used their beaded inset construction for a classic, furniture-like finish, paired with the Hanover door style and sleek slab drawer fronts for a more transitional feel.

The soft blue paint you’re seeing is Shiloh’s Niebla Azul, a perfect hue for a home near the ocean—cool, calm, and sophisticated. We paired it with a custom wood range hood and floating shelves to introduce warmth and natural contrast.

To complete the space, we installed Viatera’s Calacatta Suprema quartz countertops, mitered at a dramatic 6cm thickness and cascading into a waterfall leg on the peninsula. The subtle veining plays beautifully with the cabinetry color while offering durable, easy-care performance.

In the Living Room

Just beyond the kitchen, the living room cabinetry brings in a fresh but grounded tone with Aristokraft’s Winstead door style in Maple stained Quill. These built-ins echo the warmth of the kitchen’s shelving and hood, tying the open-concept space together. 

Floating shelves mirror the kitchen’s design, offering space for display while keeping the room light and airy.

And for visual continuity, we carried the Calacatta Suprema quartz into the living room, giving both rooms a seamless sense of flow.

Designed for Real Life

From the hidden appliance garage to the beverage center and layered lighting, this project was designed with real living in mind. It’s a functional space for entertaining, relaxing, and everyday life—all while being effortlessly beautiful.

There is something timeless about the combination of black and wood tones. When it is done right, it feels grounded, elevated, and warm all at the same time.

This Ponte Vedra kitchen remodel is a perfect example of how contrast and craftsmanship can come together to create a space that feels both refined and inviting. With a mix of painted cabinetry, rich walnut accents, and custom architectural details, every element was designed with intention.

A Bold Foundation with Black Inset Cabinetry

The perimeter of this kitchen features Shiloh inset cabinetry in maple, painted black, creating a strong and sophisticated foundation.

Inset cabinetry is known for its precise construction, where doors and drawers sit flush within the frame. It offers a furniture-style look that immediately elevates the space. In a darker finish like black, that detail becomes even more pronounced.

Paired with the Malibu door style, the cabinetry brings clean lines and subtle character without overwhelming the design.

Warmth Through Walnut Accents

To balance the depth of the black cabinetry, walnut elements were introduced throughout the space.

The island features a Reeded Malibu door style in walnut stained Rye, adding texture and visual interest. The reeded detail creates dimension and movement, especially when light hits the surface.

Walnut is also carried into other areas of the home, creating a cohesive flow between the kitchen and living spaces. This continuity helps the entire space feel connected rather than segmented.

Custom Arched Features That Define the Space

One of the standout elements in this project is the use of custom arches.

Above the sink, a custom-made walnut arch creates a focal point that softens the lines of the cabinetry and adds architectural interest. It draws the eye without feeling overdesigned.

In the adjacent living area, custom black arched bookcases with walnut countertops and walnut backs continue this theme. These built-ins provide both storage and display space while tying the kitchen and living room together visually.

These details are not just decorative. They give the home a sense of character that feels tailored and intentional.

Quartz Countertops That Bring It All Together

The countertops and backsplash feature Britannica Gold Warm quartz, which plays a key role in unifying the entire design.

Quartz offers durability and low maintenance, making it a practical choice for everyday use. At the same time, this particular selection introduces soft veining and warmth that complements both the black cabinetry and walnut tones.

By carrying the quartz up into a full height backsplash, the design feels seamless and elevated. It eliminates visual breaks and creates a clean, cohesive backdrop.

Designed for Both Beauty and Function

While the visual elements of this kitchen stand out, the layout and functionality are just as important.

Every cabinet, drawer, and surface was designed to support how the homeowners use their space. The island provides additional prep and storage, while the perimeter layout maintains efficiency and flow.

The result is a kitchen that not only looks striking but also works effortlessly for everyday life.

A Space That Feels Custom from Every Angle

What makes this kitchen special is how every detail works together.

The contrast between black and walnut.
The texture introduced through reeded cabinetry.
The softness of the arched features.
The warmth of the quartz.

None of these elements compete. Instead, they build on each other to create a space that feels layered, thoughtful, and complete.

Designed by Allie Reed

This project was designed by Allie Reed, whose work focuses on balancing bold design choices with practical, livable layouts.

Her approach is evident throughout this space. Every decision feels intentional, from material selection to architectural detail, resulting in a kitchen that feels both elevated and comfortable.

Thinking About Your Own Remodel?

If you are inspired by this kitchen and considering a remodel of your own, our team is here to help.

Visit our Jacksonville showroom to explore cabinetry, countertops, and design options in person. We will walk you through the process and help you create a space that reflects your style and supports your everyday life.
